params.detail: Walk to the gate. Hold {sprint} to run.
Take the KP-12 Ember from the bench. Press {interact}.

params.text: > ITEM: KP-12. FUNCTION: CALIBRATION. QUERY: CALIBRATE WHAT?

params.detail: Hold {aim} to aim, {fire} to shoot. Destroy the three targets.
The exit is up on the ledge. Press {jump} to fire the jetpack and land on it.
Move against the low wall to take cover.
Hold {aim} to rise from cover and shoot. Destroy the shooter.
Run at the low block and press {jump} to vault it.
Run at the long block and press {jump} to slide over it.
In cover, move along the wall to its end and keep pushing: you dash to the next one. Do it twice.
Leave the range through the exit gate into the drill hall. Range weapons stay behind.

params.text: > LINK: NONE. DIRECTIVE: NONE. QUERY: WHY?

params.detail: Take cover.
Destroy every hostile in the hall.
Resupply in the corridor: {interact} at the ammo and repair cabinets. Then enter the building and destroy the shooters in the hall.
Find the armoury rack in the hall. Press {interact} to take the rifle.
Clear the troopers in the building.
Reach the gate of the boss arena, north-east.
Destroy the SX-6. Shoot the glowing knees, then the core.

params.text: > TARGETS: ARMED. DIRECTIVE: STILL NONE. QUERY: WHO ARMED THEM?
> HOSTILES DESTROYED: 15. ORDERS RECEIVED: 0. SOURCE: UNKNOWN.
> ITEM: KR-7. FUNCTION: KILL. QUERY: WHY DOES IT FEEL HEAVY?

params.detail: You need a rifle. Take it from the armoury rack in the hall ({interact}).
The gate is open. Reach the transit node.

params.text: > SX-6: DESTROYED. GATE: OPEN. QUERY: WHO OPENED IT?

UNIT IN SERVICE
DO NOT ENERGISE

params.detail: Take a KR-7, KM-90 or KB-3 from the cyan rack and fire it. They use light rounds; the cyan crate refills them ({interact}). Your KP-12 never runs dry.
Take a KS-5 or KX-9 from the amber rack and fire it. Heavy rounds are scarce but break armor: try the steel targets. The amber crate refills them.

params.text: > RANGE: LIVE. CLASS LIGHT: KR-7, KM-90, KB-3. ROUNDS: COMMON.
> CLASS HEAVY: KS-5, KX-9. ROUNDS: SCARCE. FUNCTION: BREAK ARMOR.
> RANGE ARMS: RECALLED. KP-12: RETAINED. ROUNDS: UNLIMITED.
